title: Vanishing conductivity limit for the 1D compressible Navier-Stokes system
summary: The present article studies solutions to the compressible Navier-Stokes equations for ideal gases in one dimension when thermal conductivity is present but very weak, while viscosity is positive and constant. The main novelty is the establishment of bounds that do not explode when the conductivity coefficient approaches zero. The conductivity coefficient is assumed to be constant and the framework is that of ''{à} la Hoff'' solutions.
